hostRules.description: Read MaxMac99's private GHCR packages (meals, photonic, trip, foreman-server). A host rule set only in the Mend portal never reached the repo config (hostRules: [] in the job log), so Mend's own ghcr.io token was used and got 401. The secret tripRegistryPullToken lives in the Mend portal (homelab-k8s → Credentials → Secrets) and holds the same classic PAT (read:packages) as the Pulumi config key of that name.

packageRules.description: typescript must stay below v7: TypeScript 7 ships no compiler JS API, so typescript-eslint 8.x hard-fails on it (TS >= 7.1 support tracked in typescript-eslint#10940). The runtime is bun and unaffected; only lint and the editor care. tsconfig.json also needs moduleResolution/module rework before TS7.
All minor and patch updates share one automerged PR; majors stay separate via the rule below.
Track paperless-ngx pre-releases (v3 beta) in their own PR, automerged including majors; the reviewer ping below is the notification channel.
Keep major bumps in their own PRs for easier review/rollback. A reviewer ping notifies; the version-locked groups below come after this rule on purpose and re-group their majors.
Group ARC charts together, including majors: controller and runner are versioned jointly and must not drift while one PR waits.
Group authentik server, worker and proxy, including majors: outposts must match the server version exactly or forward auth breaks for every ingress.

Keep both Postgres clusters on the same major.minor, including majors. postgres-winkel runs the tensorchord VectorChord operand image and postgres runs the community one; docs/immich-migration.md 3.1 requires they match, and pg_dump is forward-compatible only.

Own app meals (private fork MaxMac99/meals, :main pinned by digest): checked on every run instead of only on the scheduled run, automerged including digest bumps, so a push to the fork's main reaches the cluster in minutes-to-hours. Reverting an own-app bump is trivial. Needs the ghcr.io host rule above.

Own app photonic (private, :main pinned by digest, the test deployment of photonic's main): same fast lane as meals, so a server push to photonic's main reaches the cluster in minutes-to-hours. Uses the same ghcr.io host rule.
Own app trip: same fast lane as meals.

T3 Code server and the opencode CLI it drives: same fast lane as meals, including majors. The desktop/mobile apps auto-update and refuse a server that falls behind, so every hour of lag is an hour without access.

setup-repo pin for the T3 Code pod's opencode config: own PR, automerged, nightly only. Renovate sees every commit on setup main, not just opencode changes, and each bump restarts the pod (killing running agent turns), so at most once a night.
Immich server image and chart in their own PR so the notification names the app; automerged including majors.
Home Assistant in its own PR so the notification names the app; automerged including majors.
Music Assistant in its own PR so the notification names the app; automerged including majors.
Notify on every update of these apps via a reviewer ping. assignAutomerge keeps the ping even when the PR automerges.

customManagers.description: Match the pinned Immich release constant (server + ML share it and must stay version-locked)
Match the pinned T3 Code server version (apps/t3code.ts); bootstrap.sh runs `t3 update` to it on pod start
Match the pinned opencode CLI version (apps/t3code.ts); bootstrap.sh installs @opencode/cli at it on pod start
Match the pinned setup-repo commit (apps/t3code.ts); bootstrap.sh builds the opencode config and Meridian from it on pod start
Match the digest pin of the meals fork's :main image (apps/meals.ts); kept out of the image line so the generic image regex does not read main@sha256 as a version
Match the digest pin of photonic's :main image (apps/photonic.ts); same reasoning as MEALS_DIGEST
Match Docker images in Pulumi TypeScript files
Match Docker images with separate repository and tag fields
Match Helm chart versions (Chart API with fetchOpts)
Match Helm chart versions (Release API with repositoryOpts)
Match PostgreSQL image version in CloudNativePG
